items.label: UV Protection
items.value: Made from UPF 50+ fabric with full-sleeve coverage, this sun shirt blocks over 98% of UV rays, shields your arms and torso from strong sunlight, ideal for fishing, hiking, and surfing adventures

items.label: Camo Sleeve Designs
items.value: With jungle and ocean camo sleeve prints, this shirt combines style and performance; Whether fishing or surfing, the bold patterns bring outdoor flair while blending seamlessly with your environment

items.label: Quick Dry
items.value: Crafted with 100% polyester breathable fabric, this UV shirt delivers high-performance breathability and moisture-wicking power; Whether surfing or hiking, it keeps you cool without the sticky discomfort

items.label: Comfortable Fit
items.value: Features a relaxed fit, raglan sleeves and 4-way stretch construction, this swim shirt gives you the ultimate in flexibility and ease of movement; the tagless flat seams reduce chafing and ensure comfort even during extended activities

items.label: Occasion
items.value: Perfect for Fishing, hiking, surfing, runing, camping, swimming, and beach, this shirt allows you to seamlessly transition from adventure to daily activities; Its versatile style makes it a thoughtful gift for outdoor lovers and active friends
